subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the quantity (in number of containers) and value (in crores rupees) of India's textile exports for 4 years. Based on the graph answer the question given below. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/522a9bc5228f93b75c718cecb263c474402e63a7582cbe19f805e93fdd5958bc.png] 

If, in 2007, textile containers were exported at the same rate per container as that exported in 2004, then what would be the approximate value of exports (in crores rupees) in 2007?
solution:
**Given:**

Textile exports in 2004: 400 containers, ₹340 crore

Textile exports in 2007: 450 containers

**Formula used:**

Rate per container = Value / Quantity

Value in 2007 = Rate per container in 2004 × Quantity in 2007

**Calculations:**

Rate per container in 2004 = ₹340 / 400 = ₹0.85 crore

Value in 2007 = 450 × 0.85 = ₹382.5 crore

**∴ The approximate value of textile exports in 2007 is ₹382.5 crore.**
